patch.value: GH-1719: beforeMutation guards cannot see the acting author, so packages cannot write actor-aware policy or verify that a preview and its write share one identity

GH-1719 (filed 2026-11-13). BeforeMutationHookContext, the context passed to api.hooks.beforeMutation guards, carries pm_root, operation, before, after, changed_fields and sdk but not the acting author or agent. Packages therefore cannot express actor-aware policy that multi-agent trackers need: only the claiming agent may close or release an item, an agent may not approve its own plan or review, an automation identity may write only inside its namespace. It also leaves author propagation unverifiable: in the memory package's review (its issue 51), an injected host client previewed an import without the invocation author while the following write carried it, and no hook could observe the difference. Proposal from the issue: a read-only actor block on the context, identical across CLI, SDK and MCP, with author (the resolved history author), source (argv, env, settings or fallback) and optional agent provenance (harness, model, instance) already recorded in history; previewItemMutations and dry runs pass the same actor as the write they preview; hosts must supply a real actor, never a placeholder. Related: pm-z9x1r2 (closed) resolves the harness identity this block would expose; pm-gh1656 (open) adds a transaction-owned finalization step to commitItemMutations, the same preview and commit seam. Duplicate check: searched BeforeMutationHookContext actor author guard; no open item covers hook-visible identity.

A beforeMutation guard can refuse a close whose actor is not the item's claim owner, with tests through the CLI, the SDK and an injected host client; previewItemMutations and the following commitItemMutations present an identical actor to the guard; Hooks registered without reading actor keep working unchanged, and the actor block is documented as host-supplied and never a placeholder
A guard sees the resolved author, its source and the agent provenance of the mutation it judges
BeforeMutationHookContext has no actor, so guards cannot enforce ownership and preview/write identity drift is invisible
